# Jotform

> Jotform is a comprehensive no-code platform for building forms, apps, tables, workflows, and AI agents with 20,000+ templates and 100+ integrations.

Jotform provides an all-in-one solution for data collection, automation, and collaboration. The platform combines drag-and-drop builders with extensive template libraries, payment processing, e-signature capabilities, and deep integrations with popular business tools like Slack, Microsoft Teams, Salesforce, and Google Workspace.

## Core Platform

- [Free Online Form Builder & Form Creator for 2026 | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com): Jotform homepage: drag-and-drop form builder for registrations, applications, orders, payments

## Template Libraries

- [20,000+ Free Online Form Templates & Form Examples | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/form-templates): 20,000+ customizable form templates for applications, orders, feedback, surveys
- [800+ Free No-Code App Templates | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/app-templates): 800+ no-code app templates: scheduling, booking, automation with drag-and-drop
- [300+ Free Table Templates | Jotform Tables](https://www.jotform.com/table-templates): Jotform Tables: 300+ templates for CRM, budgets, social media, task management
- [200+ Free Workflow Templates | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/workflow-templates): 200+ workflow templates for order processing, recruiting, expenses, training
- [7,000+ Free AI Agent Examples | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/agent-templates): 7,000+ AI agent templates for customer support, sales, education automation
- [1,000+ Free Board Examples | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/board-templates): 1,000+ board templates for project management, planning, collaboration

## Document & Signature Solutions

- [2,000+ Jotform PDF Templates | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/pdf-templates): 2,000+ customizable PDF templates for document generation and forms
- [900+ Jotform Sign Templates | Jotform](https://www.jotform.com/pdf-templates/e-sign): 900+ e-signature templates for contracts and business agreements
